regressions: Mailbox render overflow and callback dispatcher both failed before on API 27/34; pass after. Ordered events retain their capacity and priority; close drops pending receipts.
ownership: Each worker boundary owns 32 ordered records/512 KiB encoded text and one conflated receipt/512 KiB encoded text, plus its currently processed record. Immutable text/event representations share no mutable/native ownership. Close fences admission and drops pending receipt; exact original process retirement remains unchanged. These text bounds are not total heap measurements.
limits: No physical Android UI CPU-time measurement or native process-kill test; retained under T1631.
